title: Electromagnetic wave propagation in static black hole spacetimes: an effective refractive index description in Schwarzschild geometry
summary: We investigate electromagnetic wave propagation in static, spherically symmetric black hole spacetimes using a covariant and gauge-invariant framework based on the established Maxwell perturbation formalism. Building upon known parity decompositions and gauge-invariant master equations, we reformulate the resulting radial dynamics entirely within Schwarzschild coordinates and introduce an effective refractive-index description of electromagnetic propagation in curved spacetime.
